newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank offers one-year rrp at 13.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank offers one-year rrp at 13.5 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it started offering one-year reverse repos at 13.5 percent.
Traders said the central bank's action was aimed at setting a benchmark for the one-year bills after the rate fell at the auction on Monday.
"It wants to indicate where the one year should be. And the rate is in line with the market trend at the secondary market," a foreign bank dealer said.

Interest rates currently show an inverted yield curve with the one-year lower than the short-term rates as the market continues to be cautious after the peso was battered in recent months by speculation, dealers said.
